title: Kissed Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A spicy, tender chicken tagine with a coconut‑cream sauce that is indulgent yet keto‑friendly.
instructions: Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, paprika, and cayenne.
Heat coconut oil in a heavy‑bottomed pot over medium‑high heat and brown the chicken thighs on all sides for about 8 minutes; remove and set aside.
Add diced onion to the pot and sauté until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in lemon juice and coconut cream, stirring to deglaze and combine.
Return the chicken to the pot, add chicken broth, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 35 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce thickens.
Taste the sauce, adjust seasoning if needed, and serve hot over cauliflower rice or roasted vegetables.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
